common_pivot_preflight.scope: Six axis minors only; not a projective constant-rank theorem.

exact_criterion: For each normalized pencil, rank([U;UT;...;UT^5])=9139, where the stack has shape 9768x9139.
implication_if_decisive: Surjectivity of the exact homogeneous degree-six Macaulay map makes the pencil cokernel zero from degree six onward; A(b) then has column rank 9139 at every geometric point of that projective line.
limitation: Even five decisive star-line certificates would not cover P^5 and would not by themselves prove global Stage-B emptiness.
run_observations: The first attempted launch was refused before allocation because free+speculative memory was 0.07 GiB, below the 6 GiB guard.
A later guarded attempt reached the common pivot inversion but stopped at the independent inverse-product check before any Krylov rank; this produced no certificate.
The inverse path was changed to in-place FFLAS with integer-rounded modular verification, but the corrected script was not rerun because free+speculative memory again fell below 6 GiB.
